Couple Sues Landlord Over Rent Hike After Announcing Pregnancy

A couple in San Francisco has taken their landlord to court after the rent was significantly increased immediately after they announced a pregnancy. This situation highlights the high property costs and demand for housing in the city, leading some landlords to raise rents substantially to encourage tenants to leave, rather than pursuing lengthy eviction processes.
